important_mistakes: Use the recurring master's usual 09:00 start instead of the effective October 2 exception.

Treat Robert or Patrick as essential to the handoff because they are required Finance-review attendees.
Infer personal availability from inaccessible calendars, empty results or invitation responses.
Move existing meetings, claim that a scheduled meeting happened, or imply that the August worksheet exception was resolved.
